datasets.description: Built-up presence (binary) in a 10m x 10m grid. From the Atlas of Human Settlements 2021 @ Syria.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/syria-built-up-surface]
datasets.details: This limited public release covers the countries of Turkey and Syria for the year 2021, showing the extent of human settlements. This geospatial data is a machine-learning inference-based product that meets stringent model quality tests but has not been physically ground-truthed in the field. Glide: EQ-2023-000015-TUR

lineage.description: Built-up surface presence was derived from satellite imagery analysis using advanced deep learning (encoder-decoder CNNs) and computer vision techniques to classify 10m x 10m grid cells as built-up or non-built-up across Syria. The resulting binary raster represents spatial distribution of building infrastructure without hazard or impact context.
